title: Binance Launches Limited-Time Promotion for bStocks in Spot Liquidity Provider Program (2026-08-24)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As Binance conducts regular reviews of its programs to provide users with the most value and competitive services, Binance will be updating its  Spot Liquidity Provider Program  effective from  2026-08-24 00:00 (UTC) . Promotion Period : 2026-08-24 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-10-18 23:59 (UTC) Key Highlights A new  bStocks  category is introduced to the Spot Liquidity Provider Program. Under the bStocks category, participants are classified into  Tier 1 to 4  based on their  Weekly Maker Volume percentage  achieved on  bStocks . The new Binance Spot Liquidity Provider Program is as follows: Tier Weekly Maker Volume  Percentage  /Absolute Maker Volume Requirement And/Or Weekly bStocks Maker Volume  Percentage  Requirement Maker Fee  (Rebate) Taker Fees 1 0.05% / 25,000,000 USD Or 0.05% 0.0000% Standard taker fees as per user’s VIP level 2 0.15% 0.10% -0.0040% 3 0.50% 0.30% -0.0060% 4 1.00% 0.60% -0.0080% How the Rule Applies A participant's  bStocks tier  is determined by their Weekly Maker Volume percentage on  bStocks . When a participant reaches a bStocks tier, the corresponding  maker fee rebate  is applied across  all symbols  traded by that participant. Example:  A market maker (MM) whose  original category tier  is  Tier 1  (based on the existing Spot program's qualification), and who through  bStock  svolume achieves  bStocks Tier 3  (Weekly Maker Volume percentage ≥ 0.30%), will receive the  Tier 3 maker fee rebate  (−0.0060%) applied to  all symbols . Notes: First performance review week: 2026-08-24 00:00 (UTC) – 2026-08-30 23:59 (UTC); First promotion tier effective: 2026-09-01 00:00 (UTC) – 2026-09-07 23:59 (UTC). Final performance review week: 2026-10-12 00:00 (UTC) – 2026-10-18 23:59 (UTC); Final promotion tier effective: 2026-10-20 00:00 (UTC) – 2026-10-26 23:59 (UTC). During the campaign's early stages, the Weekly Report may not yet display the bStocks tier. When a MM's bStocks tier is greater than their original tier, Binance automatically upgrades the MM to the higher bStocks tier. For any questions, please reach out to your Key Account Coverage. How to Participate Automatic Participation:  Users with Weekly Maker Volume that equals or exceeds Tier 1 requirements of the Binance Spot Liquidity Provider Program are automatically enrolled. Manual Application (trial period):  Users whose current 30-day Maker Volume has not met Tier 1 requirements, but has a trading volume of over 20,000,000 USD equivalent on Binance Spot market can apply for a trial period of four weeks, where the users will enjoy Tier 1 maker fee rebates during this period. Please email  mmprogram@binance.com  or contact your Key Account Coverage or sales to provide proof to apply for the trial. Terms and Conditions: This program is limited to the spot and margin pairs listed on Binance.com. Participants whose account performance does not qualify them for any eligible program tier for three consecutive weeks will be removed from the program. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. Binance reserves the right to disqualify user’s reward eligibility if the account is involved in any dishonest behavior (e.g., wash trading, illegally bulk registered accounts, self dealing, or market manipulation). Binance reserves the right to determine and/or amend or vary these Terms and Conditions, its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the timing of any act to be done at its sole discretion for any reason, including: Changes in applicable regulations or policies; Obligations arising out of law or decisions issued by common courts or public administration; Anti-money laundering or combating financing terrorism rules; Technical issues beyond our control; Necessity to protect users from potential losses; Necessity to protect Binance from the loss of reputation; Extraordinary events or circumstances beyond our control (force majeure).
